correctness.rationale: Unitary equivalence to ordinary OU adjoint (Bruno et al Lemma 4.2) and classical symmetric second quantization (van Neerven; Araki et al) give the exact singular multiset, for all p>0 by convergent geometric products. Direct two-by-two exponential yields sigma± and Hilbert-Schmidt determinant. At fixed singular-value product, the cosh(p eta) argument rigorously proves strict increase with absolute shear. At degenerate rank-one endpoint the Kalman determinant equals -2 sqrt(ab)(a+b), ensuring a positive finite-time Gramian. The explicit two-vector Gramian determinant integral has leading t^4 ab(a+b)^2/3, and the exact D=Dstar+delta*r^2 identity proves the claimed coupled limit. The code passed 1404 diagnostics, but finite sampling is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fixing two decay rates and stationary Gaussian covariance while varying only a physically constrained nonnormal shear gives a natural family with identical eigenvalues, trace and operator norm but strictly different every-Schatten masses. The exact near-degenerate-noise window delta~t^2 explains a structural change in short-time spectral mass from t^-2 to t^-4 with a sharp coefficient. The full classification in this canonical two-mode family supplies meaningful nonnormality and hypoellipticity diagnostics beyond a routine table computation, while citing broader known components.
